say:1:1430127501:1.text: From a purely mining perspective, it's much simpler to mine than echorite.
say:1:1430127501:1.source_cn: 从开采的角度来说，它可比开采深岩晶简单多了！

say:2:1430127502:1.text: But these materials need to be used by smiths and other craftsmen to make weapons and tools. They need to figure it out.
say:2:1430127502:1.source_cn: 但你知道的，这些矿石最终是要被那些工匠制作成武器工具。
say:2:1430127502:1.male: But these materials need to be used by smiths and other craftsmen to make weapons and tools. They need to figure it out.
say:2:1430127502:1.female: But these materials need to be used by smiths and other craftsmen to make weapons and tools. They need to figure it out.

say:3:1430127503:1.text: I hope the weapons and tools we produce in the future will satisfy our buyers... especially those in the Empire.
say:3:1430127503:1.source_cn: 希望制作出的武器工具能够让买家们满意。
